rules: One accent: signal orange. No second accent colour; acid green is not part of this brand.
The ramp orders stages; it never grades the reader. No red/amber/green for maturity.
Square corners and hairlines; collage shapes (circle, arch, tilted square) are the only curves.
People: only real, consenting people, grayscale with a light dot screen. Objects: halftone cut-outs.
Generated images never pose as real work, real clients, real screens or real people.
Every claim, number and name comes from brand/CLAIMS.md, which follows my-cv-tailor/CAREER-TRUTH.md.
No logo exists: use the text wordmark with the orange slash, never a drawn mark.
No emoji as icons; append U+FE0E to ↗ so Apple renders text.
